description: Search Work Items using structured filters, escaping values into a Lucene query. Returns `{query, results, links?, totalCount?, truncated?}` with concise item summaries. Provide `projectId` to search one project; omit it for the global `getAllWorkItems` search, which requires global read access. Use this for common filters; use `getWorkItems` or `getAllWorkItems` directly for advanced Lucene syntax, custom response fields, or includes.

assignee.description: Assignee user ID, not a display name or email address.

createdAfter.description: Inclusive date/time lower bound for creation, in a format JavaScript Date.parse accepts.

filters.description: Additional exact field/value filters; unknown fields are rejected.

field.description: Valid Work Item field ID, including custom fields available in the project.

value.description: Exact value to match; escaped and quoted before adding to the Lucene query.

max_items.description: Maximum results collected, from 1 to 1000; also used as page size if `page_size` is absent.

page_size.description: Maximum items returned in the requested page, from 1 to 1000.

projectId.description: Optional project ID; omit to search across projects, subject to global read permissions.

sort.description: Valid Work Item field ID; prefix with `-` for descending order. Unknown fields are rejected.

statuses.description: Limit results to these workflow status IDs.

text.description: Text to match in the Work Item text fields searched by Polarion.

types.description: Limit results to these Work Item type IDs.

items.description: Work Item type ID, such as `requirement`.

updatedAfter.description: Inclusive date/time lower bound for last update, in a format JavaScript Date.parse accepts.

name: search_work_items
title: Search Work Items
